subject: English
question_text: Write the summery of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Tiger is the largest and most ferocious animal. It is a powerful and courageous animal. Now, the Royal Bengal Tigers live in the Sunderbans. But once they lived in Sylhet, Chattogram Hill Tracts and the Madhupur Jungles. Some greedy people are killing them for their own interests. The Cheeta is another animal which is known as one of the swiftest animals. The spotted leopard of Bangladesh is one of the most beautiful of animals. Monkey is another kind of animal. It is now found in the villages. It has a small round head and large eyes.
